notes: The town's radio. Each time Club Wired opens (scene 8: 0x1ba45) it deals a playlist of 16 distinct songs from the 81 credits (tables/music.json; 0x1bae7) and plays one of them at random at once, through once, not looping.

The screens that run the radio task (0x2a972: Club Wired, NAME ENTRY, Pepper's guide via 0x298de; the schedule and the records opened from Club Wired, which keep its music) start another song at random from the playlist once no music has played for 5 seconds (60 x 5 frames). The original keeps per-song played flags that nothing sets, so a song can come round again.
A screen with music of its own (a talk scene's track, the town map's) plays that instead; the radio waits for silence. Before Club Wired has opened there is no playlist, so the radio is quiet.
